Done. The build passes.

I extended the business-day rule in `BusinessDay.roll` to skip public holidays as well as weekends:

- Added a fixed `PUBLIC_HOLIDAYS` set: 2026-01-01, 2026-01-26, 2026-04-25, 2026-12-25, 2026-12-28.
- The roll-forward loop now continues while the date is a weekend **or** a listed holiday, advancing one day at a time to the next non-holiday business day.

This single change covers all three call sites (`BuildOwner`, `BulkSignup`, `RejectDailyLimit`) since they all funnel through `BusinessDay.roll`. The full test suite is green (`BUILD SUCCESS`, 1 test, 0 failures).

Note the calendar interacts with weekends the way you'd expect: 2026-12-25 (Fri) rolls through the weekend and past 12-28 (the Mon holiday) to 12-29 (Tue).
